warnings: Training source: completed POS ingredient consumption only; stock source: live inventory snapshot.
SARIMA uses calendar-day totals with seven-day seasonality.
Product filters show store-wide ingredient demand, not predicted product sales.
Prediction intervals are the SARIMA model intervals; measured 95% coverage has not been established.
Operational training: 369 covered POS days through 2026-10-13; generated CSV usage is excluded.
3 unknown calendar days are causally estimated from earlier covered weekday amounts for model continuity. They are marked IMPUTED, are not POS observations, and are not measured sales.
Historical data ends 2026-10-13; forecasting bridges a 1-day gap.
Catalog identities, units and reorder points use raw-materials-and-products.csv; current stock uses the live snapshot. The catalog supplies no lead time or safety stock, so these default to zero.
